definitions.explanation: Lasting for only a limited period of time; not permanent.

examples.japanese: これは{一時的|いちじてき}な{解決|かいけつ}に{過|す}ぎない。
examples.english: This is only a temporary solution.

examples.japanese: {一時的|いちじてき}に{仕事|しごと}を{休|やす}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm temporarily taking a break from work.

examples.japanese: {痛|いた}みは{一時的|いちじてき}なものだった。

notes:
{一時的|いちじてき} is a na-adjective meaning temporary or momentary.

WORD FORMATION:
{一時|いちじ} (temporary, for a time) + {的|てき} (adjectival suffix)

FORMS:
- {一時的|いちじてき}な + noun: temporary ~
- {一時的|いちじてき}に: temporarily (adverb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一時的|いちじてき}な{解決|かいけつ}: temporary solution
- {一時的|いちじてき}な{措置|そち}: temporary measure
- {一時的|いちじてき}に{中断|ちゅうだん}する: to temporarily suspend

OPPOSITES:
- {継続的|けいぞくてき}: continuous
- {永久的|えいきゅうてき}: permanent
- {恒久的|こうきゅうてき}: permanent, lasting
